description: Diagnose Electron build/packaging errors from electron-builder, electron-forge, or electron-packager output. Identifies common failures: code signing errors, native module rebuild issues, ASAR packaging problems, missing platform-specific configuration, and __dirname path resolution bugs.

buildTool.description: Which build tool produced the error. Defaults to 'unknown' (auto-detect).

errorOutput.description: The build error output (stderr/stdout) to diagnose

name: electron_diagnose_build_error
